highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 delivers Skia m153 with current upstream rendering correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback may select a different face after this engine update; use an explicit or bundled typeface where selection must be deterministic.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic fallback selection matters.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 153 and includes the current upstream correctness, buffer-upload, and bug-fix syncs.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 opened the m153 line with the engine update and upstream bug fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m153 line for stable publication.

harfbuzz_summary: Hardens the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native build configuration without changing its managed API.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m153 engine update.
v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.body: Linux font fallback can select a different face; use explicit or bundled typefaces where that selection must be deterministic.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m153 update for stable publication.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 delivers the stable Skia m153 release.
v4.153.0.body: It includes current upstream rendering correctness fixes.
